verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can download the OpenAPI ("Swagger") schema alongside a Postman collection. A hands-on probe retrieved the spec without authentication from /openapi/mesh-api.json and parsed it as OpenAPI 3.0.3 covering customer, case, audit, export and transaction resources. The 404s at conventional paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known) only affect discoverability and do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: discoverability at standard well-known spec paths, and evidence that the spec covers every documented endpoint.
